To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a new deep learning method for single-model QA, called DL-Pro that uses a distance matrix as a representation of protein models and a classifier based on stacked autoencoder, is developed, and the DL-Pro method is evaluated on selected CASP targets and outperformed other methods.
DL-PRO, a novel deep learning approach, outperformed existing methods for single-model quality assessment.

(1) A new method based on distance matrix and machine-learning techniques, called DL-pro, is developed for protein single-model QA; (2) The DL-pro method is able to identify the native-like models and outperforms state-of-the-art scoring/energy functions; (3) The DL-pro approach is able to predict the quality of a protein model in the form of a score, which is an important feature of the model.
